|ingredients = {{Name|Red Cabbage|1}}{{Name|Radish|1}} |edibility = 96 }} '''Red Plate''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients. Red Plate may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, in the [[Traveling Cart]], or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Red Plate may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |love=Penny |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Red Plate is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Red Plate is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Red Plate is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Red Tuxedo]].
